overview.text: The State Bank of India (SBI), Administrative Office, Bhubaneswar, is seeking a vendor for the supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and comprehensive annual maintenance contract (AMC) of Biometric Access Control Systems (BACS). The tender covers approximately 235 branches/offices/complexes, with specific focus on Currency Chest Branches in the Bhubaneswar region.

scope.text: Supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and comprehensive annual maintenance (AMC) of Biometric Access Control Systems (BACS) for SBI Administrative Office branches.
The work includes furnishing labor, material, equipment, and appliances necessary to install and maintain the BACS and AMC of existing systems on an 'as-is where is' basis.

Services include replacement of faulty equipment (switches, sensors, power modules), mandatory monthly visits for Currency Chest Branches, and compatibility integration with the Central Monitoring Station (CMS).
The contract term is valid for 2 years plus an additional 1 year, subject to annual performance review.

key_requirements.text: Bidders must submit Application cum EOI documents duly filled, signed, and stamped on each page.
Bidder must execute a Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (Annexure 'H') covering all terms and conditions.
The vendor must have a technical support SLA with the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for 05 years applicable to the entire contract period.
Visits and technicians must be carried out only by the vendor's own firm or dealer; subcontracting is not permitted.

eligibility.text: The vendor shall not employ any person who is not an Indian National and must strictly abide by Central/State labour regulations including Minimum Wages, Workmen Compensation, PF, and ESI.
No employee of the Bank is allowed to work as a vendor for two years after retirement without previous permission.

important_dates.text: Pre-Bid Meeting on 28/01/2026 at 11.00 AM via GeM Portal.
Last date of submission of tender as per the GeM Portal (opening to be announced).
The rate contract shall be valid for a period of 02 years + 01 years from the date of awarding the contract, subject to review yearly.

commercial_requirements.text: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of ₹ 100/- in form of Demand Draft (DD) to be uploaded on GeM portal.

The rate quoted by the bidders shall remain firm and shall cover all works mentioned in scope of work under this tender including contractors' profit, transportation charges and all statutory levies, insurance, applicable taxes, and any other statutory component.
No advance payment or part payment allowed; payment will be made as per actual installation of items and services availed on submission of a GST bill.

project_duration.text: The rate contract shall be valid for a period of 02 years + 01 years from the date of awarding the contract, subject to review yearly, based on satisfactory performance of the firms/vendor.
The rate contract may, at the sole discretion of the Bank, further extendable up to 01 Year as deemed necessary by the Bank on the existing rate, terms and conditions.
No request for extension will be entertained and the bidder must plan and mobilize his resources for the satisfactory completion of the project within the period agreed in the tender.
The vendor on completion of new installation will submit... (no specific duration constraint mentioned other than NIT stipulated period)

Tenure of awarded Contract shall be for one year, which may be extended/renewed yearly subject to maximum up to two further years (Total three years) after annual review at the same service rate and under the same terms.
Agreement may be renewed at the sole discretion of the Bank subject to review of performance.

important_conditions.text: The vendor shall assume all responsibilities and fully indemnify the Bank against liabilities and consequences of any damages to any part/equipment of the building and any accident/injury to any person during execution of work.

The vendor shall be responsible for the application/implementation of labour laws, all other social security enactments applicable to such works and workmen and compensation for injury and accident to person, if any, to the injured person employed by it.

The Bank reserves its right to cancel the entire contract in whole or part at any time without assigning appropriate reasons in the event of one or more of the following conditions: i. Delay in completion of the work beyond the specified period for reasons solely ascribed to the bidder.

If the contractor fails to improve the standards of safety in its operation to the satisfaction of SBI/Bank after being given a reasonable opportunity to do so, the Bank shall have the right to take corrective steps at the risk and cost of the contractor.
